name: Ethiopia Yirgacheffe
description: Bright and floral with notes of jasmine, bergamot, and stone fruit. A washed single origin roasted light to keep its delicate aromatics intact.

name: Colombia Huila
description: Balanced and sweet with caramel, red apple, and a smooth cocoa finish. An easy daily drinker.

name: Sumatra Mandheling
description: Full bodied and earthy with dark chocolate, cedar, and a syrupy mouthfeel. Roasted dark for depth.

name: Meridian House Blend
description: Our signature blend of Central and South American beans. Chocolate, toasted nut, and a clean finish. Great for espresso or filter.

name: Nightshift Espresso Blend
description: A bold espresso blend built for milk drinks. Dark cocoa, molasses, and a lingering sweetness.

name: Decaf Brazil Cerrado
description: Swiss Water decaffeinated. Nutty and smooth with milk chocolate and a gentle sweetness. All the flavour, none of the caffeine.

name: Decaf Espresso Blend
description: A decaffeinated espresso blend with dark chocolate and caramel. Rich crema without the jitters.

name: Pour Over Dripper
description: Ceramic V60 style pour over dripper. Makes a clean, bright cup. Pairs well with our light roasts.

name: Precision Coffee Scale
description: 0.1g resolution scale with built in timer. Dial in your brew ratio every time.

name: Kenya Nyeri AA
description: Juicy and complex with blackcurrant, tomato, and a bright citric acidity. A benchmark Kenyan coffee. Currently out of stock.
